compiled_state.title: GREEN: add inference-challenge mode to plugins/dso/agents/red-team-reviewer.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Extend plugins/dso/agents/red-team-reviewer.md with a conditional Inference-Challenge Mode section that satisfies all RED test assertions from T1 and T4.

## Changes to red-team-reviewer.md
Add a '## Mode' section near the top with two values: 'story_review' (default, existing behavior) and 'inference_challenge' (new). When mode is 'inference_challenge', the agent follows the inference-challenge protocol instead of the story-map gap analysis.

Add '## Inference-Challenge Mode' section with:
- Protocol: agent receives decisions_log entries from PRECONDITIONS context and evaluates each for inference-vs-explicit sourcing
- Tiered sampling instructions:
  - If affects_fields includes 'gate_verdicts' or 'workflow_completion_checklist': ALWAYS emit INFERENCE_CHALLENGE (100% rate)
  - Otherwise (rationale-text-only): emit challenge only if hash(decision_id) mod 5 == 0 (deterministic 20%)
  - Document the hash function: SHA-256 of decision_id, take last 8 hex chars, parse as int, mod 5
- '## Sampling Tiers' subsection documenting the 100%/20% tiers with the hash_bucket formula
- NEVER return silence — always emit one of the two envelope types

Add '## Output: INFERENCE_CHALLENGE' section documenting the envelope schema per inference-envelope.md contract.
Add '## Output: INFERENCE_SKIP' section documenting:
  - reason field: 'sampling' (hash_bucket check failed) | 'not_in_scope' (no decisions_log provided)
  - hash_bucket field: the computed hash(decision_id) mod 5 value (0-4)

Add '## Ticket Comment Emission' section documenting:
  - When INFERENCE_CHALLENGE is emitted, instruct orchestrator to call: .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <ticket_id> with payload: {decision_id, challenge_type, evidence_against_inference, user_confirmation_required}
  - Emission is conditional (orchestrator responsibility) so tests can stub the CLI call
  - decision_id format: <session_id>:<content_hash> per inference-envelope.md

## Constraint
Do NOT remove or modify the existing story_review mode content. Add inference-challenge as an additive conditional section. Existing Phase E behavior must be unchanged.

## Acceptance
All tests in test-red-team-inference-challenge.sh and test-red-team-inference-comment-emission.sh pass.
